title: Gems SMP
description: The mod i made for a personal server a long time ago that has extra armors and tools that are past netherite
body:
This Mod was made for an SMP that I owned for quite a while and how i madw many of my frinesds so I am finally releasing it to the public for people to enjoy. Ill put as many details as i can below form what I have documented

If I am missing anything let me know so i can update the description for it as its been a while since I worked on this

These are all upgrades to Netherite with each or spawing in a diffrent biome and each armor/tool set does someting diffrent

Ruby - 
Fire resistance + regen self on hit
Crimson Forests

Galaxium -
Blindness on hit + resistance
The End

Asterism gem -
Set Bonus - Strength + Glowing
Sword 1 (T1-2) - N/A
Sword 2 (T3)  - Right Click 5 Heart (30 min Cooldown)
Sword 3 (T4) - Wither 2 + Slowness 2
The End

green painite -
Jump boost + Poison(T3) + Tron disk(Just a bow Iirc)
Jungle Biomes

Pumpkin -
Regen + Jump Boost
Hill Biomes

Spinel -
Drill + Strength 1

T1 Drill: Haste 3
T2 Drill: Haste 5
Lush Caves + Dark Oak

Heliotrope -
Wither and Mining Fatigue on hit
Tiaga Biomes

Mushroom -
Poison  + nausea on hit
Mushroom field

Sapphire -
Speed + Weakness on hi
Snow biomes

pietersite -
Jump boost + speed
Forest

Who knows maybe one day Ill bing this server back
